Aleksandar Pavlovic.summary: Aleksandar Pavlović is a Germany defensive midfielder from Bayern Munich who gives the national team press resistance, calm distribution, and midfield screening.
Aleksandar Pavlovic.note: Pavlović gives Germany structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Aleksandar Pavlovic.noteZh: 他给Germany控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Alexander Nübel.note: Nübel gives Germany a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Alexander Nübel.noteZh: 他在Germany首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Angelo Stiller.note: Stiller is midfield insurance for Germany. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Angelo Stiller.noteZh: 他给Germany一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Antonio Rüdiger.note: Rüdiger is defensive cover for Germany's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Antonio Rüdiger.noteZh: 他是Germany在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Assan Ouedraogo.note: Ouédraogo is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Germany, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Assan Ouedraogo.noteZh: 他给Germany提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

David Raum.note: Raum gives Germany cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
David Raum.noteZh: 他是Germany后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Deniz Undav.note: Undav has given Germany both the finish and the pass, including goals against Curaçao and Côte d'Ivoire. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Deniz Undav.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了Germany的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Felix Nmecha.note: Nmecha has both scored and created for Germany in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Felix Nmecha.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Germany贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Florian Wirtz.note: Wirtz has been a provider for Germany, creating goals against Curaçao, Ecuador, and Paraguay. His best moments come when he plays the pass before the defense is ready.
Florian Wirtz.noteZh: 他已经多次帮Germany制造进球。看的是明显机会出现前的那脚传球。

Jamal Musiala.note: Musiala is on the scoresheet for Germany, with his goal coming against Curaçao. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Jamal Musiala.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Jamie Leweling.note: Leweling is midfield insurance for Germany. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Jamie Leweling.noteZh: 他给Germany一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Jonathan Tah.note: Tah gives Germany one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Jonathan Tah.noteZh: 他是Germany无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Joshua Kimmich.note: Kimmich has been a provider for Germany, creating goals against Curaçao. His best moments come when he plays the pass before the defense is ready.
Joshua Kimmich.noteZh: 他这届赛事的价值在于供给Germany的进攻。他能在防线移动还没完成时看见跑动。

Kai Havertz.note: Havertz has been one of Germany's real scoring stories, with goals against Curaçao and Paraguay. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Kai Havertz.noteZh: 他已经是Germany这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Leon Goretzka.note: Goretzka is midfield insurance for Germany. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Leon Goretzka.noteZh: 他给Germany一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Leroy Sane.note: Sané already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Ecuador. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Leroy Sane.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Malick Thiaw.note: Thiaw is the kind of defender Germany can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Malick Thiaw.noteZh: 他是Germany艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Manuel Neuer.note: Neuer has carried the keeper minutes for Germany. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Manuel Neuer.noteZh: 他是Germany防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Maximilian Beier.note: Beier is the forward Germany can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Maximilian Beier.noteZh: 他给Germany替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Nadiem Amiri.note: Amiri has already created a goal for Germany in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Nadiem Amiri.noteZh: 他已经参与了Germany的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Nathaniel Brown.note: Brown has shown both sides of the attacking job for Germany. One action can pull the defender, and the next one can decide the chance.
Nathaniel Brown.noteZh: 他给Germany展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Nick Woltemade.note: Woltemade is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Germany, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Nick Woltemade.noteZh: 他给Germany提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Nico Schlotterbeck.note: Schlotterbeck already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Curaçao. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Nico Schlotterbeck.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Pascal Groß.note: Groß is midfield insurance for Germany. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Pascal Groß.noteZh: 他给Germany一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。
